parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the resources.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description:
The resources that you want to move.

>  You can move a maximum of 10 resources at a time. If you want to move more than 10 resources, move them in batches.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager move-resources --resource-group-id rg-aekzmeobk5w0000 --resources ResourceId=i-23v380000 Service=ecs ResourceType=instance RegionId=cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager MoveResources --region cn-hangzhou --Resources.1.ResourceId 'i-23v380000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzmeobk5w0000' --Resources.1.Service ecs --Resources.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Resources.1.ResourceType instance --method POST --force
